name: mirage
text: The app and engine have it right: PinnWire is modelled as 100 requests per DAY per key, resetting at midnight UTC (8 pm Eastern), not per month. And PinnWire's own account read, which the engine trusts over its own count, says the keys really are used up fast: at 21:38 UTC 11 of your 12 keys show 0 of 100 left and one has 24 left. So it's spending them quickly, not misreading the limit. There is no day-pacing on PinnWire today, so the keys drain early. I've noted the fix (CH60b): spread the 100 a day per key across the engine's hours and check what spends them, since SharpAPI already carries Pinnacle prices.
